claude.sample_unit: patient cases (210 clinical pharmacist-identified drug-related problems)

links.outcome: Direct detection of intervention-requiring drug-related problems by LLMs versus pharmacist gold standard
links.effect: Direct detection limited (51.4%-60.5% across models), nearly half missed initially; guided prompting improved detection to 93.8%-98.1%.
links.quote: Direct detection of intervention-requiring DRPs was limited (51.4%-60.5% across models), with nearly half missed initially.

links.outcome: LLM output accuracy against clinical pharmacist gold-standard, including hallucinations
links.effect: All models produced hallucinations; recommendation concordance with the CP exceeded 70% in most DRP categories; direct detection 51.4%-60.5%.

unlisted_practices: Expert-guided structured follow-up prompting to improve LLM drug-related problem detection (hybrid pharmacist-AI workflow)

links.effect: Guided prompting improved overall detection to 93.8%-98.1% from direct 51.4%-60.5%.
links.quote: Guided prompting significantly improved overall detection rates to 93.8%-98.1%, with ChatGPT achieving the highest accuracy.

links.effect: Direct detection was 51.4%-60.5%, with nearly half missed initially.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrate meaningful potential to assist in DRP detection but are not sufficiently reliable as standalone tools.
